summary: Ran M5-S01's declared molecular tests: both always-on checks (xml, manifest) plus the two declared checker acceptance tests, from the build directory. All 6 XML files parsed; the manifest was structurally consistent (5 members across ListView and Report, each covered by a file, each file mapping to a member, no wildcards); check_list_views_and_compact_layouts.py at build scope exited 0 ('No issues found.'); check_report_inventory.py at step scope exited 0 (score 100, 'Scanned 1 report/dashboard file(s); 0 finding(s) detected.'); check-outputs returned ok with no missing/empty/malformed paths. The one declared manual test (Given/When/Then, queue-name cross-check plus the Tier 1 interim-view claim) names observable outcomes and was recorded verbatim for the milestone gate rather than ticked. 0 failures; step moved built -> tested.
confidence_rationale: Every declared test ran (two checkers, both always-on checks) or was correctly classified as manual; both checkers exist and were invoked verbatim with no flag rewritten; every exit code and check-outputs result was observed directly by this run rather than assumed from the prior envelopes.

process_observations.observation: Both declared checkers passed cleanly on the first invocation this run, with no repairs or re-runs needed, and check-outputs confirmed all 6 declared outputs present, non-empty and well-formed.

The step reaches tested with its report shipping without the Escalated criterion that gives it its purpose (Q91): no cited skill carries a report column code for Case.IsEscalated, so the report as written returns open Cases from the last 30 days rather than escalated open Cases, and neither declared checker can detect a missing filter criterion.

The declared folder filename reports/Support_Operations-meta.xml does not match the .reportFolder-meta.xml form check_report_inventory.py's FOLDER_SUFFIXES recognises, so acceptance_tests[1]'s folder-sharing assertion never executes inside that checker even though the test exits 0; this run's own manifest check treated the file as consistent with package.xml based on its <ReportFolder> content rather than its filename, which is a judgment call for the milestone gate to affirm or overturn.

The manual acceptance test bundles two distinct observable outcomes (each view's <queue> resolving under artefacts/M2-S04/queues/, and the Tier 1 General view's presence as an interim surface) into one Given/When/Then line, which a human ticks as a single unit even though the second clause is a standing policy note rather than a per-file check.

M5-S01 is now tested with two findings the M5 gate has not yet adjudicated (the absent Escalated criterion, the folder filename/checker mismatch); build-doc-keeper should carry both into decisions.md before the gate.
process_observations.followup_reason: because it is the agent that records step findings into decisions.md ahead of a milestone gate, and both findings currently exist only in the prior envelopes and deploy-order.md.
